stop.title: This counter cannot sell yet
stop.not_persistent: Chrome has not given this counter permanent storage, so it could delete unsynced bills. Install the POS app (the install icon in the address bar) and open it again. If this stays, call the manager.
stop.unavailable: The counter's database cannot be opened. Use current Chrome or Edge, close other POS windows, and reload. If this stays, call the manager.
stop.too_new: This counter's database was made by a newer version of the POS. Reload to get the newest version. Do not clear the browser's data.
stop.damaged: The counter's database is damaged. Do not clear the browser's data: call the manager, so unsynced bills can be saved.
stop.outbox_unreadable: The list of bills waiting to sync cannot be read. Do not clear the browser's data: call the manager.

setup.title: Set up this counter
setup.help: A manager creates a one-time code in the back office (Counters). Enter the shop code and that code.
setup.enrollment_failed: That code is wrong, used or expired. Ask the manager for a new one.
setup.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then try a new code.
setup.offline: Setting up needs the internet. Check the connection and try again.

unlock.title: Who is selling?
unlock.noStaff: No staff with a PIN yet. A manager gives each person a temporary PIN in the back office (Staff).
unlock.wrong_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} try left before you are locked on this counter.
unlock.wrong_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} tries left before you are locked on this counter.
unlock.locked: Locked on this counter after 5 wrong PINs. Ask a manager to unlock you.
unlock.no_pin: You have no PIN yet. Ask a manager for a temporary PIN.
unlock.recorded: Every bill is recorded under the person who unlocked the counter.
unlock.managerFor: Unlock {{name}}: a manager picks their name and enters their own PIN.
unlock.notAllowed: This person can't unlock others on this counter. Ask a manager.
unlock.managerLocked: This manager is locked on this counter too. Ask another manager, or the owner can give a new temporary PIN in the back office.

choosePin.title: Choose your own PIN
choosePin.help: Your PIN was given by a manager. Choose your own: 4 to 6 digits that only you know.
choosePin.mismatch: The two PINs are not the same.
choosePin.offline: Saving your PIN needs the internet, so every counter learns it. You cannot sell until it is saved.
choosePin.wrong_pin: The temporary PIN was not accepted. Ask the manager for a new one.
choosePin.failed: Your PIN could not be saved. Ask the manager.

pinProblem.sequence: Do not use a run like 1234 or 4321.
pinProblem.is_short_code: Do not use your short code.

status.refused: The server does not accept this counter. Call the manager.
status.offlineWarning: This counter has not reached the server for {{hours}} hours. Bills are safe here and will sync when the internet is back.
status.offlineStrong: This counter has not reached the server for {{days}} days. Bills are safe here, but tell the manager now.

catalog.loading_one: Loading the catalog… {{count, number}} item so far
catalog.loading_other: Loading the catalog… {{count, number}} items so far
catalog.help: The first time, this counter downloads the whole catalog. Afterwards it searches without the internet.

search.label: Search
search.placeholder: Part name, code, OEM number or vehicle
search.hint: Type words of the part name in any order, a code, an OEM number, or a car and year: fan belt cultus · 17801 · brake pads corolla 2012.
search.none: No items match “{{text}}”. Try fewer words, or the OEM number.

bill.title: Bill
bill.empty: Press Enter on a result to add it. A scanned label adds at once. Type 2* before the search for 2 of it.
bill.saveFailed: This bill can’t be saved on this counter. Don’t lock or reload: finish it, and call the manager.

price.title: Price
price.label: Unit price (whole rupees)
price.noList: This item has no price. Type the price; it needs an approval.

clear.title: Clear this bill?
clear.body: Everything on the bill is removed. Nothing has been saved as a sale or printed yet.

approval.title: Approval needed
approval.below_floor: Below the floor price: someone who may sell below the floor approves.
approval.below_list: Past your discount limit: someone whose own limit covers it approves.
approval.who: Who approves? Pick your name, or type your short code.
approval.wrong_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} try left before this person is locked on this counter.
approval.wrong_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} tries left before this person is locked on this counter.
approval.locked: This person is locked on this counter. Ask another approver.
approval.notAllowed: This person can’t approve this. Ask a manager.
approval.credit_limit: Over this customer’s credit limit: someone who may approve credit over the limit approves.
approval.offline_cap: Over today’s offline credit for this customer on this counter: someone who may approve credit over the limit approves.

error.invalid_quantity: That quantity isn’t allowed: more than 0, at most 9,999, and whole unless the item is sold by length or volume.
error.too_many_decimals: Too many decimals: prices are whole rupees, quantities have at most 3 decimals.
error.price_required: This item has no price: type one.
error.invalid_discount: A discount can be at most 100%.
error.discount_too_large: The discount is more than the bill.
error.unknown_line: That line isn’t on the bill any more.
error.invalid_tender: These payments don't pay the bill.
error.invalid_customer: A customer’s bill doesn’t take a walk-in phone.
error.invalid_phone: That isn’t a phone number: 7 to 15 digits.
error.credit_approval_pending: This bill goes over the customer’s credit: it needs an approval.
error.note_too_long: A note is at most 200 characters.
error.return_over_quantity: That's more than can still come back of that line (some came back already). Start the return again.
error.bill_not_empty: A return starts on an empty bill. Hold this bill (F8) or finish it first.
error.empty_return: Type how many come back of at least one line.
error.original_required: That line isn't on the bill.
error.return_approval_pending: This return needs an approval first.
error.no_return: There is nothing coming back on this bill.
error.return_customer_mismatch: A return keeps the original bill's customer.
error.refund_approval_pending: A refund by transfer needs a manager's approval first.

pay.notReady: The payment methods haven't arrived on this counter yet. Wait for the sync, then try again.
pay.lessThanTotal: That's less than the total. Use Split payment if the rest is paid another way.
pay.failed: This bill couldn't be saved on this counter. Try again; if it happens again, call the manager.

reference.card: Card slip number or approval code

pay.done: Bill {{number}} printed · bring {{cash}} to the cash desk
pay.doneChange: Bill {{number}} printed · bring {{cash}} to the cash desk, change {{change}}

tender.no_payment: Enter how the bill is paid.
tender.unknown_method: That payment method isn't active on this counter.
tender.on_account_needs_customer: On account needs a credit customer.
tender.duplicate_method: Each payment method can be used once.
tender.amount_not_positive: Every amount must be more than 0.
tender.reference_required: Enter the reference for this payment.
tender.reference_too_long: A reference has at most 40 characters.
tender.sum_mismatch: The payments must add up exactly to the total.
tender.cash_received_without_cash: Cash received needs a cash amount.
tender.cash_received_short: Cash received is less than the cash amount.
tender.refund_one_method: A refund goes back one way only.
tender.refund_needs_account: Only a customer with an account can be credited.
tender.cash_received_on_refund: A refund takes no cash received.
tender.even_takes_no_payment: An even exchange takes no payment.

reprint.title: Reprint a bill
reprint.help: This counter's bills of the last 30 days. Type part of the number; ↑ ↓ and Enter reprint.
reprint.none: No bill of the last 30 days has that number.
reprint.empty: No bills on this counter in the last 30 days.

print.policy: Exchange or return within 30 days with this bill.

desk.balanceAfter: Balance after (as of the last sync)

print.refundAtDesk: Refund due {{amount}}, collect at the cash desk

health.title: Counter health
health.help: How this counter is doing. Bills are kept here until the server has them.
health.notPersisted: Not permanent: Chrome may clear it
health.attentionHelp: The server refused these bills. They stay on this counter. A manager can try again after the problem is fixed.

error.bad_schema: The server could not read it
error.id_conflict: Another bill already has its id
error.seq_conflict: Another bill already has its number
error.unknown_reference: It names an item, person or payment method the server does not know

health.wrong_one: Wrong PIN. {{count}} try left before this manager is locked.
health.wrong_other: Wrong PIN. {{count}} tries left before this manager is locked.
health.locked: This manager is locked on this counter.
health.notAllowed: Only a manager who gives PINs (admin.devices) can do this.

diagnostics.title: Send diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Sends this counter's recent log and health to support, after a manager's PIN. Nothing personal is sent.
diagnostics.offline: Not sent: the counter is offline. Try again when it is back online.
diagnostics.not_permitted: Not sent: the server says this manager may not manage counters.
diagnostics.failed: Not sent. Try again; if it stays, tell support.

revoked.title: This counter was removed
revoked.body_zero: It was removed in the back office. Nothing is waiting to sync.
revoked.body_one: It was removed in the back office. {{count}} bill on it has not reached the server: do not clear this PC, call the manager.
revoked.body_other: It was removed in the back office. {{count}} bills on it have not reached the server: do not clear this PC, call the manager.
revoked.help: A manager can re-enable it under Counters in the back office; its bills then sync.

customer.title: Customer
customer.help: Search by name, phone or code. Walk-in is the first row; a walk-in may leave a phone so the bill can be found later.
customer.badPhone: That isn’t a phone number: 7 to 15 digits.

credit.title: On account · {{name}}
credit.overLimit: Over the credit limit by {{amount}}: a manager approves when you finalize.
credit.overCap: Over today’s offline cap by {{amount}}: a manager approves when you finalize.
credit.notPermitted: Your role can’t sell on account

desk.title: Cash desk
desk.empty: Nothing waiting. New cash bills appear here within seconds.
desk.scanHelp: Scan the bill’s code, or pick it with ↑ ↓ and press Enter
desk.offline: Offline since {{time}} · the queue is not updating · scan each bill
desk.noSession: No session open on this desk
desk.otherSession: {{name}}’s session is open since {{time}}. Only they take cash; you can still sell (Alt+Q).

open.title: Open a session
open.help: Count the cash already in the drawer. It is your float for this session.
open.label: Opening float (whole rupees)

correct.title: Cash received for {{number}}
correct.help: Type what the salesman actually brought. The bill stays as printed; your correction is kept on the handover.
correct.label: Cash received (whole rupees)

unknown.title: {{number}} isn’t in the queue yet
unknown.body: Its counter hasn’t synced, or this desk is offline. Record {{amount}} from the bill? The server matches it when the bill arrives.

collect.title: Receive a customer payment
collect.help: Find the customer by name, phone or code, then press Enter.

cashOut.title: Cash out of the drawer

kind.void_cash: Cash given back for a voided bill

cashOut.note: Note: what it was for, who took it
cashOut.reference: Reference (optional: bill, slip or voucher number)

count.title: Count the drawer
count.help: Count each note and coin. The expected cash shows after the count.
count.ackLabel: A manager acknowledges the variance with their PIN
count.ackNeeded: A manager enters their PIN, or tick Acknowledge later.
count.notAcknowledger: That person can’t acknowledge a variance on this session.
count.left: Stays in the drawer for the next session (the rest goes to the safe)

voidCash.title: Cash taken for voided bills
voidCash.help: The counter voided these bills, but this desk had taken their cash. Give it back to whoever handed it over: a manager enters their PIN. A reissued bill is collected from the queue as usual.
voidCash.approve: Give back {{amount}} taken for the voided bill {{number}}. Someone who may void, not the cashier, enters their own PIN.

handover.nothing_to_collect: Nothing to collect: this bill was paid without cash.
handover.not_session_cashier: Only the cashier of the open session takes cash. Close it first, or ask them.
handover.not_permitted: Your role can’t take cash at the desk.
handover.already_handed_over: This bill is already handed over.
handover.received_short: That’s less than the amount due. The bill can’t be handed over short.
handover.session_open: A session is already open on this desk.
handover.invalid_float: Type the float in whole rupees, 0 or more.
handover.original_unpaid: This refund's bill hasn't been handed over yet: collect the bill's cash first, then pay out the refund.

collection.not_session_cashier: Only the cashier of the open session takes cash.
collection.not_permitted: Your role can’t receive customer payments.
collection.reference_too_long: The reference is at most 40 characters.
collection.note_too_long: The note is at most 200 characters.

cashOut.not_session_cashier: Only the cashier of the open session pays out cash.
cashOut.not_permitted: Your role can’t pay cash out of the drawer.
cashOut.extra_target: Choose only what this kind needs.
cashOut.note_required: Say what it was for, and who took it.
cashOut.note_too_long: The note is at most 200 characters.
cashOut.reference_too_long: The reference is at most 40 characters.
cashOut.over_drawer: Only {{amount}} should be in the drawer. Pay out anyway? Press Enter again.

close.no_session: No session is open on this desk.
close.not_permitted: Your role can’t close a session.
close.invalid_count: Type whole numbers of notes and coins.
close.left_invalid: What stays is whole rupees, from 0 to the count.
close.reason_required: Choose why the drawer is short or over.
close.note_required: Say what happened in the note.
close.note_too_long: The note is at most 200 characters.
close.own_variance: The session’s own cashier can’t acknowledge its variance.
close.not_acknowledger: That person can’t acknowledge a variance.

hold.title: Hold this bill
hold.help_one: The bill with its {{count}} line is set aside on this counter, as it is now. Recall it with Shift+F8 before the end of the day.
hold.help_other: The bill with its {{count}} lines is set aside on this counter, as it is now. Recall it with Shift+F8 before the end of the day.
hold.label: Label (optional)
hold.labelHint: e.g. Blue Suzuki, waiting for old part
hold.empty: The bill is empty: there is nothing to hold.
hold.failed: The bill couldn't be held or recalled. Try again; if it keeps happening, call the manager.

error.too_many: 20 bills are held on this counter already. Recall or clear one first.
error.label_too_long: The label can be at most 40 characters.
error.empty_bill: The bill is empty: there is nothing to hold.
error.not_found: That held bill isn't on this counter any more.
error.bill_open: Hold or finish the open bill first.

recall.title: Recall a held bill
recall.help: Your bills held on this counter today, newest first. ↑ ↓ and Enter recall; Del clears one.
recall.swap: Your open bill has lines. Enter again holds it and recalls {{name}}.
recall.confirmClear: Clear {{name}}? Its lines are removed for good. Del or Enter again to clear.
recall.empty: You have no bills held on this counter.

void.title: Void a bill
void.help: This counter's bills of today. Type part of the number or scan the bill; ↑ ↓ and Enter choose it.
void.none: No bill of today on this counter has that number.
void.empty: No bills of today on this counter to void.
void.approve: Void {{number}}: it keeps its number and prints as VOID. Someone who may void enters their own PIN, with the reason.
void.approveAsked: Offline: the cash desk couldn't be asked, and you answered that the cash for {{number}} hasn't been handed over yet. Void it: it keeps its number and prints as VOID. Someone who may void enters their own PIN, with the reason.

ask.cashTitle: Has the cash been handed over?
ask.cash: Has the cash for {{number}} already been handed over at the cash desk?
ask.cashHelp: The cash desk can't be asked right now. Check with the cashier: once the cash is handed over, it is a return, not a void.
ask.account: Has the shop's {{method}} account received {{amount}} for {{number}}?
ask.accountHelp: Check the account's app or the payment SMS: once it has arrived, it is a return, so the refund is recorded.

void.moneyArrived: The money for {{number}} has reached the shop: return what comes back, so the refund is recorded.
void.paymentMissing: {{amount}} by {{method}} hasn't reached the shop. Ask the customer to complete it, then return the bill.
void.handedOver: {{number}} was handed over at {{at}} by {{by}}: it can't be voided. Use a return.
void.handedOverHere: {{number}} was handed over at this desk: it can't be voided. Use a return.
void.failed: The bill couldn't be voided. Try again; if it keeps happening, call the manager.
void.reissueBody: A new bill starts with its customer, lines and prices, to correct and pay like any bill.
void.reissuing: Reissue of {{number}}: correct the bill, then pay
void.holdFirst: Your bill has lines: hold it (F8) or finish it, then reissue {{number}} from its lines by hand.

error.other_device: That bill was made on another counter: void it there.
error.other_day: That bill is of another day: use a return.
error.handed_over: The cash desk has taken that bill's cash: use a return.
error.window_none: That person's role doesn't allow voids.
error.note_too_long: The note can be at most 200 characters.
error.money_arrived: The money has reached the shop: use a return.
error.payment_missing: A payment hasn't reached the shop yet: ask the customer to complete it, then return the bill.

return.title: Return / exchange
return.help: Scan the customer's bill, or type its number, a phone number or a date. Enter opens the bill.
return.search: Bill code, number, phone or date
return.none: No bill of the last 90 days found. Check the number, or use No receipt.
return.notHere: That bill isn't on this counter yet. Wait for the sync, or use No receipt.
return.linesHelp: Sold {{date}}. Type how many of each line come back, with the reason and the condition. Enter puts them on the bill.
return.allBack: All of it has come back already.
return.markSomething: Type how many come back of at least one line.
return.noReceiptHelp: Find each item and type how many come back. The refund price starts at the lowest price of the last 90 days; a manager approves it with their PIN.
return.ref: Old bill number, if the customer knows it (optional)
return.suggested: Lowest price of the last 90 days: {{price}}
return.noSuggestion: No sale in 90 days and no price: type the refund.
return.holdFirst: A return starts on an empty bill. Hold this bill (F8) or finish it first.

need.return_permission: Your role can't process returns: someone who may approves it.
need.return_outside_policy: This return is outside the return policy (too old, or a category that isn't returnable).
need.no_receipt_return: A return without a receipt needs a manager's PIN, and the refund price is theirs.
need.refund_transfer: A refund by transfer needs a manager's PIN.

return.doneRefund: Return {{number}} printed · refund {{cash}} at the cash desk
return.doneAccount: Return {{number}} printed · {{amount}} credited to the account
return.unpaid: The cash for {{number}} hasn't been handed over at the cash desk yet. Void it and reissue it without what comes back: a return would pay out money the shop never received.

refund.atDesk: The bill goes to the cash desk's queue; the cashier pays out the refund.
refund.transferApproval: A manager approves the transfer with their PIN next.
refund.needsCustomer: Only a customer with an account
refund.evenBody: What comes back pays for what goes out exactly: nothing to pay or refund.

voidCash.no_cash_taken: No cash was taken for that bill.
voidCash.already_given_back: The cash for that bill has already been given back.
voidCash.not_session_cashier: Only the session's cashier can give cash back.
voidCash.not_permitted: That person can't pay out cash.
voidCash.approver_required: A manager enters their PIN first.
voidCash.approver_is_cashier: The cashier can't approve their own give-back.
voidCash.approver_not_permitted: That person can't approve it: someone who may void enters their PIN.
